title_sq: Vile Luksoze Individuale per shitje prane Natyres se Qete
description_sq: Vile luksoze Individuale per shitje prane Natyres se qete, Vila eshte e organizuar ne katin perdhe me ambientet ndihmese, lavanderi, tualet, dhome per miq me ambient gatimi si dhe ambient palestere. Ne katin e pare, ndodhet ambienti i dites + ambienti i ngrenies i vecuar. Ne katin e dyte ndodhen tre dhoma gjumi secila me tualet te dedikuar dhe nje ballkon. Vila eshte e arreduar ne stil modern, me parket, investime elektrike dhe hidraulike moderne,gjenerator dhe sistem ngrohje-ftohje. Ne oborrin e jashtem ka siperfaqe te konsiderueshme gjelberimi dhe pishine individuale. Gjithashtu vila disponon 1 parkim te jashtem dhe nje post parkimi i mbyllur. Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni.
title_en: Luxury Individual Villa for sale near the quiet Nature
description_en: Individual luxury villa for sale near the quiet nature, the villa is organized on the ground floor with utility rooms, laundry room, toilet, guest room with cooking area and gym area. On the first floor, there is a living room + a separate dining room. On the second floor there are three bedrooms, each with a dedicated toilet and a balcony. The villa is furnished in a modern style, with parquet, modern electrical and plumbing investments, generator and heating-cooling system. In the outer courtyard there is a considerable green area and an individual swimming pool. Also, the villa has 1 outdoor parking and a closed parking post. For more information, contact us.
